column1: # Empty context = plain UI string (tl!, t).
# @plural = plural forms: one|other (only 1 is "one" in Italian; "app" doesn't change).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of ArtCraft Launcher's English labels, in standard Italian.
# The interface addresses the user as "tu", as Italian software usually does. "App" is feminine
# ("l'app è installata"), so statuses about an app agree with it.
# Coverage: the whole interface: every menu string and tl! literal (complete_menus = true).
# Left in English on purpose: product name "ArtCraft Launcher" (and its "Launcher" tag), suite
# name "Craft App Suite", app names (PhotoCraft, LightCraft, FilmCraft, DesignCraft, VectorCraft,
